name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: COMPOSE-WINDOW-TRIGGER BUILD, not for production: trunk's production Sqlite.sys.mjs-based cleanup logic, unchanged, plus one new trigger -- runs immediately when the user opens a new message-compose window (browser.windows.onCreated, type=messageCompose), in addition to the existing shutdown-time run. Tests whether opening a compose window (short of actually sending) recovers or avoids the mid-session reading breakage.
